# Third-party browser assets

- `lil-gui` 0.20.0 — MIT — https://github.com/georgealways/lil-gui
- `lil-xgui` 0.1.0 — MIT — https://github.com/segalion/lil-xgui

The distributed files are precompiled browser assets. `lil-xgui.min.js` only changes its module import to reference the adjacent local `lil-gui.esm.min.js` file.
